pages.text: $(l)Thermal Series$() (Thermal Expansion and friends) is the classic Redstone Flux tech set: dynamos make power, machines spend it, and Servos and Ducts move everything between them.$(br2)Its signature alloys come from the Induction Smelter.

The Induction Smelter is not a crafting recipe, so signalum, lumium and enderium are priced by hand at $(l)Tier 4$() and $(l)Tier 5$(). Thermal's mined metals sit at $(l)Tier 2$().$(br2)Everything else Thermal makes is an ordinary furnace or crafting recipe MC3DPrint already derives on its own.
